intent: A compact weekly agenda with a travelling day selector, time-anchored event cards and expandable meeting notes, including a considered empty day.

layout.direction: Keep a compact weekly schedule: a 20px sans heading and timezone, a travelling pressed-day selector, a 30px Instrument Serif date heading and time-anchored event disclosures. Preserve the 48px time gutter, 14px event titles and notes, 12px mono time metadata, 44px controls and neutral ruled card. Notes open inside each event; the work remains the focus.
layout.container: Size to the parent with @container. Keep the root width at 100%, capped to the focused component, with 24px desktop and 16px narrow padding.

motion.entrance: Enter the whole agenda with opacity and an 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: Move the shared day indicator over 220ms; enter each keyed day list with opacity and a 6px rise over 250ms; rotate disclosure chevrons over 150ms.
motion.reduced: Subscribe to live prefers-reduced-motion changes. Stop and settle owned entry/list controls immediately and use a static selected-day indicator with no layout travel.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: timezone
props.description: Display timezone for host-supplied local times.

props.name: days
props.description: Ordered days with stable unique day IDs and stable event IDs within each day. Date, start, end and timezone strings are host display labels, without parsing or conversion.

props.name: defaultDay
props.description: Initial day ID; missing or removed IDs fall back to the first available day. Empty data can arrive later.

props.name: onEventSelect
props.description: Synchronous notification with an independent flat event record on either disclosure activation. Day selection stays local; the host owns external actions.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Keep AgendaEvent, AgendaDay and WeekAgendaProps. Use stable unique day IDs and stable event IDs within each day as React keys so collection reordering retains focused buttons and open event state.

Only one day is selected and one event disclosure is open at a time. Day buttons expose aria-pressed; event buttons expose aria-expanded and instance-scoped aria-controls. Native Enter and Space activate both controls. Changing day closes event details.

onEventSelect receives a new flat event snapshot synchronously on each disclosure activation, including closing it. Do not let callbacks mutate the host days/events. Local disclosures work without a callback; the host owns navigation and persistence.
The initial defaultDay selects a matching day, with the first available day as fallback. Keep a written empty-day state and a no-dates state for an empty list, and accept later-arriving schedules.
Date, start, end and timezone values are host display labels. Render them as provided; do not add parsing, timezone conversion, sorting, asynchronous saves or invented calendar rules.
Wrap long titles, locations and notes without document overflow. Keep independent agendas and disclosure IDs separate.
